title: English Grammar in Use for Teens: Tenses
subject: English
description_short: This course covers present, past and future tenses with theory, examples, common mistakes and exercises. It is for lower secondary students who want clear, practical grammar practice.
outcomes: use present simple and present continuous to talk about routines, facts and actions happening now
form and use present perfect for experiences, results and unfinished time
choose between past simple and present perfect using time clues
describe finished past actions and past actions in progress
talk about the future with will, be going to, present continuous and present simple
